case.title: Silent Timeout
case.author_invariant: The static key names the only live watch. A start replaces its deadline, cancel removes the key without scheduling work, and a timer emits only if it remains the active generation after every same-tick external command.

worked_value.note: External commands have phase 0, so cancellation exactly at the deadline wins over the phase-1 timer.

story.premise: A night watch opens when a patrol leaves and should alarm three ticks later unless the patrol checks in. A new departure replaces the deadline; a check-in exactly at the deadline still cancels it.
story.submission: Submit a canonical PULSE 0.1 program and, optionally, a short invariant note.
story.diagnostics: The verifier exhaustively checks 545 zero-to-three-command traces over six ticks, including repeated starts, stray cancels, and same-tick start/cancel order determined by source EventId.
hints: A timeout and a debounce are not the same: cancellation produces no replacement timer.
Use one static timer key for the watch.
Every external command at a tick runs before a timer due at that tick.
